senses.gloss: m. (Syr. bubia sartago, P. Sm.; prob. = בי אפיא, פ softened through assimilation, cmp. תפייא a. בי תפי) a frying pan, sometimes used as a coal pan containing the coal over which things are roasted.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 30b">Pes. 30ᵇ</cite> <he>האי בוב׳</he> (Ms. M. 2, Ms. Oxf. Ar. and old ed., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 10); <cite ref="Zevachim 95b">Zeb. 95ᵇ</cite> (Ms. R. 1 <he>מביא</he>, corr. <cite ref="B01083"><he>בו׳</he></cite>; Ms. K. <cite ref="B00244"><he>בוכיא</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Shabbat 29a">Sabb. 29ᵃ</cite> he threw the date stones <he>לבוביא</he> Ms. M. a. Ar. (<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 4:3:5">Y. Bets. IV, 62ᶜ</cite> <he>לתפייה</he>, v. Rashi to Sabb. l. c.) into the pan. [Editions vary betw. <cite ref="K00186"><he>כוביא</he></cite> a. <cite ref="B00244"><he>בוכיא</he></cite>.]
